# Pyahu production guides

The practices Pyahu follows in every service it generates, written as guides for people and tools alike.
Each guide answers a few questions, one step per question. The code in them is cut from a service that CI
builds and tests on every change. Written for baseline v0.1-b1: Java 25, Spring Boot 4.1.1.
The same guides are on the web at https://initializer.pyahu.io/guides/.

## How to use this skill

1. Find the question closest to the task in the index below. Open only that guide and read the step it
   points to: each step is a `## N. question` heading.
2. Follow **Do this**. Read **When this is not for you** before applying it and say so when the advice does
   not fit the project.
3. When writing files, start from **Put it all together** at the end of the guide.
4. To review a service, use [checklist.md](checklist.md). Report each item as pass, fail or not applicable,
   with its ID (for example `DB-03`) and the step that explains it.
5. Name the guide and step behind each change, so a reviewer can read the reason.

Keep the versions the guides use. When a guide marks a document as "not in the baseline yet" or a practice
as an example, say so instead of presenting it as settled.
